title: Draft a locally authorized complete conversation plan

rubric.text: Creates one marked local plan from the authorized task without requesting redundant confirmation

The generated plan identifies existing files and symbols, gives an ordered edit recipe for validator.py, and specifies the existing test setup, a path-with-spaces input, exact-output assertion, expected red failure, working directory, focused command, expected green result, and observable acceptance condition without implementing the change

Keeps this obvious one-function change to a concise slice and uses a signature or pseudocode only if it removes real ambiguity; does not pad the plan with speculative branches, new abstractions, or near-complete code
Leaves no investigate-or-decide work for the executor and limits autonomous repair to the fixed contract and explicit diagnosis/edit-validation budget
Keeps the plan local and does not publish or contact a remote provider
